universalAnswers.whatHappened: OpenAI released a Data agent in ChatGPT Work on September 10.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: It is a workplace data tool that can connect an approved ChatGPT Work account to company data, investigate a question and build a dashboard.
universalAnswers.evidenceBasis: OpenAI's release and current business/plugin control pages, plus VentureBeat's same-day interview reporting.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: OpenAI has not published an external accuracy benchmark, and the independent report did not test the product's answers.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: A plain-language dashboard can still inherit the company's permissions, metric definitions, source quality and errors.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: Professionals and teams using ChatGPT Work with administrator-approved business data connections.
universalAnswers.changesNow: The Data plugin can be installed in ChatGPT Work and connected by administrators to supported data and BI tools.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: No public benchmark establishes how accurately the external product retrieves, joins or interprets data across customer systems.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Before sharing a result, check which sources and metric definition it used, compare one important figure with the trusted report, and keep sending or changing records behind approval.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: Which data and definition produced this answer, and what happens if it is wrong?

model-tool-release.productRange: Data agent is a plugin inside ChatGPT Work, not a new general model or a replacement data warehouse.
model-tool-release.newCapabilities: It can combine approved company sources, investigate a question, build a dashboard, share findings and carry out approved connected actions.
model-tool-release.bestFitTasks: Exploring why a business metric changed, creating an initial dashboard and preparing a source-linked analysis for review.
model-tool-release.notFor: It is not independent proof that a number or causal explanation is correct, and OpenAI has not published an external correctness benchmark.
model-tool-release.nearestAlternatives: Existing BI tools and analysts can query the same governed data directly; Data agent adds a conversational route across several connected sources.
model-tool-release.availability: OpenAI lists Data in the Plugins directory in ChatGPT Work; administrators manage installation, data-source configuration and access.
model-tool-release.freePaidBoundary: The release is limited to ChatGPT Work and depends on workplace administrator and connector access; no consumer Free or Plus availability is announced.
model-tool-release.costBoundary: OpenAI announced no standalone Data agent price on the release page; connector, platform and ChatGPT Work costs are not resolved by that absence.
model-tool-release.limitations: Source quality, business definitions, existing permissions, action settings and the missing public benchmark remain important boundaries.
model-tool-release.technicalExampleProportionality: The article uses one sales metric example to show how a definition and source affect an answer, without teaching database administration.
model-tool-release.vendorEvidenceBoundary: Product capabilities and data commitments are attributed to OpenAI; VentureBeat establishes the missing external benchmark, not product accuracy.

translation.newsVersionExact: OpenAI released a Data agent in ChatGPT Work on September 10.
translation.actualMeaningExact: The useful change is that a colleague can ask a business question in ordinary language and receive a dashboard without first writing a database query.
translation.mechanismExact: The agent can only work with the sources its administrators connect and the records its account is already allowed to see.
translation.familiarExampleExact: Both dashboards can look polished and still answer different questions.

learningConnections.concept: Checking an AI output against source and criteria
learningConnections.learningPayoff: Practise checking a confident result against the source and definition that produced it.
